title: decisions and features wait on exactly the conditions they need

criteria.text: A condition is a record with a why, an owner, a status and, where one exists, the check that decides it
criteria.note: Built in #1225 (`20261111120000_knowledge_conditions.sql`); CN-0001 to CN-0016 recorded 2026-11-22 (#1418 body) [V]. Checked: `[guards F126.1]` in `supabase/tests/knowledge_conditions.sql`.

criteria.text: Conditions have parts; the parent's status is computed from its parts, never set by hand
criteria.note: `_condition_status` in #1225 [V]. Checked: `[guards F126.2]` in `supabase/tests/knowledge_conditions.sql`. #1418 (open): `part_of` is operator-only and no live path writes it, so CN-0002..16 are not yet parts of CN-0001.

criteria.text: A condition can be a number crossing a line, decided by a scheduled query
criteria.note: Scheduled-check job in #1225 [V]. Checked: `[guards F126.3]` in `tests/knowledge-conditions-job.test.ts`.

criteria.text: Two ways to wait: a decision, feature or slice links to a condition or part with `starts when` or `ends when`; waiting on a part does not wait on the whole
criteria.note: Links and their trigger in #1225 [V]. Checked: `[guards F126.4]` in `supabase/tests/knowledge_conditions.sql`. #1418 (open): `propose` and the import write no `starts_when`, so in practice nothing is linked yet; JY-LAUNCH names its waits in words.

criteria.text: Both questions in one call each: what does this condition unlock, and what is this waiting on, following parts all the way down
criteria.note: Not built [V]: #1225's body left `unlocks` / `waits_on` to the lookup tool, and `src/lib/knowledge/tools.ts` registers no such verb; no store function by those names exists. The last report's 'built' rested on a wrong reading. Build is #1491 (filed today); check #1383 follows it.

criteria.text: One batch when something is met: one GitHub Issue lists everything it starts or ends
Parked means parked: an agent asked about something parked answers with the condition it waits on, and the lookup tool refuses to mark parked work as building
criteria.note: Half built [V]: `knowledge.revise` refuses to mark parked work building and logs it (#1225). The answer half is not: no lookup verb or `lookups.ts` path mentions parked work or its condition (#1225 left it to #1219, which closed without it). Checked: only `[guards F126.7 partial]`. Filed #1493 today.

criteria.text: Runs without a computer: checks run on an Actions schedule; the PM marks a condition met or withdrawn through the lookup tool or an Actions run from his phone
criteria.note: `knowledge-conditions.yml`: daily 15:17 UTC, and by hand with condition and status inputs, only the PM's runs may mark (#1225) [V]. Checked: two `[guards F126.8 partial]` in `tests/knowledge-conditions-job.test.ts`, so no.

criteria.text: Today's waiting lines come in as proposals: `[for now]` until-text and scenarios' `gates:` and `depends:` become proposed conditions, listed for the PM in one Issue
criteria.note: Not built [V]: no import of waiting lines in `scripts/knowledge/conditions.ts` or `import.ts`; #1225 left it to a follow-on. #1385 (open).
